name: – Tomáš Zdechovský – After § 96 – Am 1
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text: 2a. Highlights the critical necessity of promptly dedicating necessary resources to ensure the timely conclusion of the ongoing investigation into the acquisition of the COVID-19 vaccine in the Union, especially considering the substantial public interest in this matter, coupled with the fact that the investigation already commenced in 2022 and to this date no decision has been publicly announced;
